column3: With respect to The Bluffs Mortgage Loan (5.0%), the Mortgaged Property is near Fort Riley military base, and approximately 67% of units at the Mortgaged Property are leased to active-duty military members. There can be no assurances that (a) a reduction in operations, personnel, or funding at Fort Riley will not adversely impact local housing demand or (b) the occupancy by active-duty military members will not be impacted by any increases to housing on base at Fort Riley or deployments.
